description: Cost Control Panel — real-time budget tracking, cost anomaly detection, circuit breaker status, and cost optimization recommendations. Provides live monitoring during active workflow runs and historical cost analysis when idle. Budget gauge, phase breakdown chart, cost event feed, and recommendation engine.

groups.name: Page Structure & Layout
groups.description: Overall layout of the Cost Control panel: header with title and refresh button, followed by budget warnings, summary cards, budget gauge + phase chart, safety section, cost feed table, and optimization recommendations.

assertions.description: The page header displays 'Cost Control' as a heading with a DollarSign icon.
Subtitle text reads 'Budget tracking, anomaly detection, and cost optimization'.
A refresh button with aria-label 'Refresh cost data' is present in the header area.
When data is loading, the panel shows a spinning refresh icon centered on the page instead of the dashboard content.
assertions.precondition: Data is still loading (isLoading is true)

assertions.description: The page renders five sections in order: (1) Budget warning banner (conditional), (2) Summary cards + budget gauge + phase chart, (3) Circuit breaker + anomaly feed, (4) Cost feed table, (5) Optimization recommendations. The page scrolls vertically with 16px padding and 16px gaps between sections.

groups.name: Summary Metric Cards
groups.description: Four metric cards in a responsive grid showing Total Cost, Total Tokens, Cache Hit Rate, and Cache Savings. Uses 2 columns on mobile, 4 on desktop.

assertions.description: A MetricCard titled 'Total Cost' displays the total cost in USD format (e.g., '$1.23' or '$0.0045') with subtitle 'Last 30 days' and a DollarSign icon.
A MetricCard titled 'Total Tokens' displays formatted token count (K/M suffixes) with subtitle 'Input + Output'.
A MetricCard titled 'Cache Hit Rate' displays the rate as a percentage (e.g., '45%') with subtitle 'Token cache efficiency'.
A MetricCard titled 'Cache Savings' displays estimated savings in USD with subtitle 'Estimated savings' and uses the success variant (green accent).
The four summary cards are arranged in a responsive grid: 2 columns on small screens (grid-cols-2) and 4 columns on medium+ screens (md:grid-cols-4) with 12px gaps.

groups.name: Budget Utilization Gauge
groups.description: Circular SVG gauge showing budget utilization percentage. Color-coded: green (<60% used), yellow (60-80%), red (>80%). Shows cost amounts and remaining percentage below the gauge.

assertions.description: The budget gauge section has a heading 'Budget Utilization' with a Wallet icon.
When no run is active, the budget gauge section shows an AlertTriangle icon with text 'No active run' and detail 'Budget tracking will appear when a run starts'.
assertions.precondition: No workflow run is currently active

assertions.description: When a run is active, the circular gauge shows: (1) a percentage number in the center (e.g., '67%' with label 'used'), (2) an SVG progress arc colored green/yellow/red based on utilization, (3) cost amounts below as '$X.XX / $Y.YY', (4) remaining percentage as 'X% remaining'. The progress arc animates smoothly over 500ms.
assertions.precondition: A workflow run is currently active with an active budget

assertions.description: The gauge arc color reflects budget health: green (#22c55e) when <60% used, yellow (#eab308) when 60-80% used, red (#ef4444) when >80% used. The percentage text color matches the arc color.
assertions.precondition: A workflow run is active

groups.name: Cost by Phase Chart
groups.description: Horizontal bar chart showing cost per workflow phase using recharts. Sorted by cost descending. Custom tooltip with token breakdown.

assertions.description: The phase breakdown section has a heading 'Cost by Phase' with a Layers icon.
When no phase data exists, displays 'No phase cost data available' centered in the card.
assertions.precondition: No phase cost data in the database

assertions.description: Hovering over a bar in the phase breakdown chart shows a tooltip with: phase name (bold), cost in USD, input token count, output token count, cache created tokens, and cache read tokens — all with K/M formatting for large numbers.
assertions.precondition: Phase cost data exists and chart is rendered

groups.name: Circuit Breaker Status
groups.description: Card showing the cost circuit breaker state: green Shield icon with 'Closed' badge when healthy, red ShieldAlert icon with 'Tripped' badge when triggered. Shows anomaly detector stats.

assertions.description: The circuit breaker card has heading 'Circuit Breaker'.
When the circuit breaker is not tripped, a green Shield icon is shown with a 'Closed' badge using the success variant. If no active budget exists, text reads 'No active budget'.
assertions.precondition: Circuit breaker is not tripped

assertions.description: When the circuit breaker is tripped, a red ShieldAlert icon is shown with a 'Tripped' badge using the danger variant. Additional text reads 'Budget exceeded or anomaly detected' in red.
assertions.precondition: Circuit breaker has been tripped by budget exceeded or cache failure

assertions.description: When an active budget exists, the card shows 'Anomaly samples: N' and optionally 'Mean cost: $X.XXXX' (only when mean > 0).
assertions.precondition: Active budget exists

groups.name: Anomaly Detection Feed
groups.description: Scrollable list of detected cost anomalies with z-scores, costs, and mean values. Yellow-tinted cards with severity indicators.

assertions.description: The anomaly feed has heading 'Anomaly Detection' with an AlertTriangle icon.
When no anomalies have been detected, the section shows 'No anomalies detected' centered.
assertions.precondition: No cost anomalies detected during the current or recent runs

assertions.description: Each anomaly entry shows: z-score value (yellow text), timestamp, the anomaly message, the actual cost (e.g., 'Cost: $0.0234'), and the mean cost (e.g., 'Mean: $0.0089'). Items are styled with yellow-tinted background (bg-yellow-500/5) and border (border-yellow-500/20).
assertions.precondition: At least one anomaly has been detected

groups.name: Budget Warning Banner
groups.description: Dismissible alert banner at the top of the page when budget warnings fire (>80% consumed). Shows remaining percentage, warning message, cost amounts, and dismiss button.

assertions.description: When a budget warning event fires, a yellow-tinted banner appears at the top of the page with an AlertTriangle icon, title 'Budget Warning - N% remaining', the warning message, and cost display '$X.XX / $Y.YY'.
assertions.precondition: A budget warning event has been emitted (budget >80% consumed)

assertions.description: Clicking the dismiss button (X icon, aria-label 'Dismiss warning') hides the warning banner. The banner stays dismissed for the current session.
assertions.precondition: A budget warning banner is currently visible

assertions.description: When multiple budget warnings exist, the banner shows the latest warning and a count of additional warnings (e.g., '+2 more warnings').
assertions.precondition: Multiple budget warning events have been emitted

groups.name: Recent Cost Events Table
groups.description: Scrollable table showing the last 50 cost events with time, phase, iteration, token counts, cost, cumulative cost, and cache hit rate. Newest events first.

assertions.description: The cost feed section has heading 'Recent Cost Events' with a List icon. When events exist, a count badge shows '(N of M)' where N is min(events, 50).
When no cost events exist, shows 'No cost events yet' centered in the card.
assertions.precondition: No workflow runs have generated cost events

assertions.description: The table has 7 columns: Time, Phase, Iter, Tokens, Cost, Cumulative, Cache. The header row is sticky (stays visible when scrolling). Cost and Cumulative columns use monospace font.
assertions.precondition: At least one cost event exists

assertions.description: Table rows have a subtle hover effect (bg-muted/20) with a smooth transition.
assertions.precondition: Table has rows rendered

groups.name: Optimization Recommendations
groups.description: Section showing cost optimization recommendations from the meta-optimizer and dashboard-derived insights. Includes cache efficiency, duplicate prompt detection, and model downgrade suggestions.

assertions.description: The recommendations section has heading 'Optimization Recommendations' with a Lightbulb icon.
When no recommendations or insights exist, shows a TrendingDown icon with 'No cost optimization recommendations yet' and 'Run workflows to accumulate data for cost analysis'.
assertions.precondition: No recommendations or insights available

assertions.description: Meta-optimizer recommendations show: a CheckCircle2 icon, recommendation title (semibold), confidence badge (colored green/yellow/gray based on percentage), status badge (pending/applied/rejected/rolled_back), and description text. The confidence badge shows the percentage value (e.g., '85%').
assertions.precondition: Meta-optimizer has generated cost-related recommendations

assertions.description: Dashboard-derived insights display as color-coded cards: blue border/background for info severity, yellow for warning, red for critical. Each shows a colored severity dot, title, and actionable description. Insights include: low cache hit rate (<30%), high budget utilization (>85%), dominant phase spending (>60%), and cache savings acknowledgment.
assertions.precondition: Dashboard data exists with actionable patterns

groups.name: Visual Design & Styling
groups.description: Design token compliance, color scheme, typography, and card styling across the Cost Control panel.

assertions.description: All section cards use consistent styling: bg-card background, rounded-lg corners, border with border-border/50 (50% opacity), and 16px padding (p-4).
All section headings use text-sm font-semibold with a flex layout containing a w-4 h-4 icon and 8px gap. Heading text is clearly legible against the card background.

Muted text (text-muted-foreground) used for subtitles, timestamps, and secondary information is legible against bg-card backgrounds. This includes: subtitle text, table cell text, empty state messages, and metric card subtitles.

Warning elements use yellow-500 consistently: budget warning banner (border-yellow-500/30, bg-yellow-500/10), anomaly items (bg-yellow-500/5, border-yellow-500/20), and warning badge text (text-yellow-500).
assertions.precondition: Warning elements are visible

groups.name: Real-Time Data Flow
groups.description: Real-time event subscription behavior: cost events update the feed table, budget warnings trigger the banner, anomaly events populate the anomaly feed, and dashboard queries refresh on cost events.

assertions.description: When an AI call completes during a workflow run, a new cost event appears at the top of the Recent Cost Events table within 1 second. The event shows the phase, iteration, token counts, cost, cumulative cost, and cache hit rate. Events are capped at 200 total.
assertions.precondition: A workflow run is active and making AI calls

assertions.description: The budget gauge and active budget status update every 5 seconds during an active run, reflecting current spend, remaining fraction, and circuit breaker state.
assertions.precondition: A workflow run is active

assertions.description: When cost-update events fire, the dashboard summary cards (Total Cost, Total Tokens, Cache Hit Rate, Cache Savings) refresh with updated data after a 300ms debounce. No fixed polling interval is used for the dashboard — updates are event-driven.
Clicking the 'Refresh cost data' button manually refreshes both the dashboard summary and the active budget status queries.

groups.name: Budget & Safety State Consistency
groups.description: Validates that the displayed budget, circuit breaker, and anomaly data is internally consistent and reflects the actual state of the cost management engine.

assertions.description: When an active budget exists, the budget gauge percentage plus the 'X% remaining' text should sum to 100%. The gauge cost display '$A / $B' should show A <= B. The gauge color should match the utilization level: green if usage < 60%, yellow if 60-80%, red if > 80%.
assertions.precondition: Active budget exists

assertions.description: In the cost feed table, the cumulative cost column should be monotonically non-decreasing when reading from bottom to top (oldest to newest). Each new event's cumulative cost should be >= the previous event's cumulative cost.
assertions.precondition: Multiple cost events exist in the feed

assertions.description: If the circuit breaker shows 'Tripped', the budget gauge should show high utilization (>80%) or the anomaly feed should contain recent entries. The tripped state should not appear when the budget gauge shows low utilization with no anomalies.
assertions.precondition: Both circuit breaker and budget gauge are visible

states.name: Loading
states.description: Initial loading state: a spinning RefreshCw icon is displayed centered on the page while cost data is being fetched. No dashboard content is visible.

transitions.name: Data loaded (no active run)
transitions.description: Cost data finishes loading with no active workflow run. Dashboard renders with 'No active run' in the budget gauge area.

transitions.name: Data loaded (active run)
transitions.description: Cost data finishes loading with an active workflow run and budget. Dashboard renders with live budget gauge.

states.name: Dashboard — No Active Run
states.description: Full dashboard visible: header with 'Cost Control' title, four summary metric cards (Total Cost, Total Tokens, Cache Hit Rate, Cache Savings), budget gauge showing 'No active run', phase breakdown chart, circuit breaker in 'Closed' state with 'No active budget', cost event feed table, and optimization recommendations section. No budget warning banner is shown.

transitions.name: Refresh cost data
transitions.description: Click the Refresh button to manually reload dashboard summary and budget status queries.

transitions.name: Workflow run starts
transitions.description: A workflow run begins, activating a budget. The budget gauge transitions from 'No active run' to showing utilization percentage and cost amounts.

states.name: Dashboard — Active Run
states.description: Full dashboard with live budget tracking: header, summary cards updating via events, budget gauge showing utilization percentage with color-coded arc (green <60%, yellow 60-80%, red >80%), cost amounts ('$X.XX / $Y.YY'), remaining percentage, phase breakdown chart, circuit breaker status (Closed), anomaly feed, live cost event feed table with newest events at top, and recommendations.

transitions.name: Refresh cost data
transitions.description: Click the Refresh button to manually reload dashboard and budget data during an active run.

transitions.name: Budget warning fires
transitions.description: Budget exceeds 80% utilization, triggering a yellow warning banner at the top of the page with remaining percentage and cost amounts.

transitions.name: Circuit breaker trips
transitions.description: Budget exceeded or anomaly detected causes the circuit breaker to trip. The Circuit Breaker card switches from green 'Closed' to red 'Tripped' badge.

transitions.name: Run completes
transitions.description: The active workflow run finishes. Budget gauge reverts to 'No active run' on next refresh.

states.name: Budget Warning Visible
states.description: Active run dashboard with a yellow budget warning banner at the top. Banner shows AlertTriangle icon, 'Budget Warning - N% remaining', warning message, cost display '$X.XX / $Y.YY', and a dismiss button. Multiple warnings show '+N more warnings' text.

transitions.name: Dismiss warning banner
transitions.description: Click the dismiss button (X icon) to hide the budget warning banner for the current session.

transitions.name: Circuit breaker trips while warning visible
transitions.description: Budget exceeded triggers circuit breaker trip while the warning banner is still visible.

states.name: Circuit Breaker Tripped
states.description: Dashboard showing a tripped circuit breaker: the Circuit Breaker card displays a red ShieldAlert icon with 'Tripped' danger badge and 'Budget exceeded or anomaly detected' message. Budget gauge shows high utilization (red). Anomaly feed may contain recent entries. Warning banner may also be visible.

transitions.name: Refresh after trip
transitions.description: Click Refresh to reload data. If the run ended or breaker recovered, state may change.

transitions.name: Run ends after trip
transitions.description: The workflow run finishes after a circuit breaker trip. On refresh, the dashboard returns to idle state.
